description: One page of individual incidents inside a lat/lon box. Counts, shares, months, and streets belong on get_area_trends. A window longer than 45 days without lat_min, lat_max, lon_min, and lon_max is refused. Chicago's portal withholds about the last seven days. New York publishes complaints after a quarter closes.

lat_max.description: North edge. Required geographic filter for a long window.

lat_min.description: South edge. Required geographic filter for a long window.

location_descriptions.description: Filter by location descriptions (e.g., ['STREET', 'RESIDENCE']). Omit for all.

lon_max.description: East edge. Required geographic filter for a long window.

lon_min.description: West edge. Required geographic filter for a long window.

place.description: Address text, such as a street name, matched against location, block, and community area. This is not a neighborhood boundary. Harbor View and other neighborhood names need the lat/lon box, or get_area_trends.

primary_types.description: Filter by crime types (e.g., ['THEFT', 'BATTERY', 'NARCOTICS']). Omit for all types.

search_text.description: Text search across primary_type and description fields.

name: get_city_crimes
